new_events.title: Tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz
new_events.description: UKMTO reports tanker hit by unknown projectile, fire extinguished. No casualties. Iran nuclear chief says wartime situation continues.

new_events.title: Tioga-Franklin Savings Bank closed - 5th US bank failure of 2026
new_events.description: Pennsylvania regulators closed Tioga-Franklin Savings Bank. Second Federal Savings and Loan assumed deposits.

new_events.title: Australia private credit crisis: Bathla Group collapse
new_events.description: Bathla Group entered voluntary administration, $3.6B private-credit debt, 2000 homes mid-construction. $200B private credit sector in storm. Fund redemptions escalating.

new_events.title: Global food shock brewing: HSBC/JPMorgan warn, wheat at 3-year high
new_events.description: Ukraine grain exports -54% to 29.6M tons. Global grain deficit 2026-27 (first since 2020-21, largest since 2006-07). Hormuz disruption hitting fertiliser/sulphur. UK warns citizens to stock up on food.

ongoing_events_updated.title: Bessent Treasury intervention vs Fed Warsh - collision course
ongoing_events_updated.description: Treasury Secretary Bessent using near-$1T General Account for bond purchases. Fed stopped Reserve Management Purchases mid-Aug. FT reports collision course with Fed Chair Warsh. Analysts call it 'paying mortgage with credit card'.

ongoing_events_updated.title: ECB September rate hike to 2.50% confirmed
ongoing_events_updated.description: Schnabel backs further rate rise. July meeting described as 'pause' not end. Inflation at ~3%, Iran war inflation, eurozone resilience. ECB governors ready to raise to 2.50% on Sep 9-10.

ongoing_events_updated.title: BOJ Himino calls for 'timely' rate hike, political pressure mounting
ongoing_events_updated.description: Deputy Governor Himino stresses timely rate hikes. Takaichi government pushing dovish policymakers. JGB 5Y at 2.155%. Yen at 159.395. Joint intervention last month. Ueda absent from Jackson Hole.

ongoing_events_updated.title: Evergrande founder sentenced to life in prison
ongoing_events_updated.description: Hui Ka Yan sentenced to life, all personal property confiscated, CN Y 15.8B fine on Evergrande. Property slump into 6th year. PBOC nudging yuan at 6.7829.

ongoing_events_updated.title: RBI intensifying rupee intervention
ongoing_events_updated.description: Bloomberg: RBI 'showing up whenever rupee weakens'. FX reserves jumped. Oil pressure offset by RBI intervention.

ongoing_events_updated.title: Ebola epidemic accelerating - 5,656 cases, 2,715 deaths
ongoing_events_updated.description: Bundibugyo ebolavirus, fastest-growing outbreak on record. 5,656 cases / 2,715 deaths as of Aug 25. Africa CDC: only 30-40% of infections detected. WHO PHEIC declared.
